title: Розповсюдження електронних листів з фейковим сканером, начебто, від імені CERT-UA (CERT-UA#5583)

entities.name: UAC-0133
entities.gloss: A threat group tracked by CERT-UA associated with cyberattacks against Ukrainian targets.

entities.name: online.ua
entities.gloss: A Ukrainian web portal providing free email and other internet services.

entities.name: sbu@online[.]ua
entities.gloss: A compromised or spoofed email address used to distribute malicious emails.

entities.name: ESET_scanner.rar
entities.gloss: A malicious RAR archive attached to phishing emails pretending to be from CERT-UA.

entities.name: ESET Online Scanner.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable that mimics an antivirus scanner to download and execute secondary payloads.

entities.name: LICENSE
entities.gloss: A file included as part of the malicious archive bundle.

entities.name: /home/gwesvnw/eset.yar
entities.gloss: A remote payload file retrieved via SFTP during execution of the malware.

entities.name: Renci.SshNet
entities.gloss: An open-source .NET SSH library utilized for SFTP file transfers.

entities.name: hxxps://github[.]com/ArsenShnurkov/Renci.SshNet
entities.gloss: A GitHub repository URL for the Renci.SshNet library fork.
An IP address used to host an SFTP server for delivering secondary payloads.

entities.name: ipfib[.]com
entities.gloss: An internet domain associated with the network infrastructure used in the attack.

relations.evidence: архів "ESET_scanner.rar", що містить файл "ESET Online Scanner.exe"

relations.head: ESET Online Scanner.exe
relations.evidence: здійснюється по протоколу SFTP з використанням бібліотеки "Renci.SshNet"

relations.head: ESET Online Scanner.exe
relations.evidence: завантаження пейлоаду ("/home/gwesvnw/eset.yar") здійснюється по протоколу SFTP
